text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.2971 for the Junior Software Engineer position. Their strongest evidence includes a computer science degree and experience with "Django" for python and web development frameworks, as well as "Docker" for devops. Key gaps include a missing must-have requirement for git, alongside several missing nice-to-have skills such as sql, nosql, html, css, javascript, and pytest. The application has been escalated for further review because the candidate is overqualified, is making a career switch, and has a low overall fit despite meeting the experience requirements.
